lines.zh: 蛇腹压过沼泽的烂泥，留下宽沟。
lines.en: My belly drags through the swamp muck, leaving a wide trench.

lines.zh: 三颗头各自看一个方向，谁也不理谁。
lines.en: Three heads watch three directions and ignore each other.

lines.zh: 我盘过倒下的树干，鳞片蹭掉树皮。
lines.en: I pour over a fallen trunk, scales peeling its bark.

lines.zh: 泥水没过半身，我照样往前走。
lines.en: Mud swallows half of me and I keep moving.

lines.zh: 蛇尾在前，三颗头在后，慢慢挪。
lines.en: Tail first, three heads trailing, I shift along.

lines.zh: 每走一步，巢里的水就浑一分。
lines.en: Every step muddies the water of my nest.

lines.zh: 我贴着芦苇走，藏住大半个身子。
lines.en: I slide along the reeds, hiding most of my bulk.

lines.zh: 一颗头探路，另外两颗在吵架。
lines.en: One head scouts; the other two bicker.

lines.zh: 沼泽的泥太软，我的重量陷得深。
lines.en: The swamp mud is soft and my weight sinks deep.

lines.zh: 我绕开自己的旧巢，那里太挤了。
lines.en: I skirt my old nest; it has grown too cramped.

lines.zh: 鳞片刮过石头，声音像磨刀。
lines.en: Scales scrape stone with a knife-sharpening sound.

lines.zh: 我拖出一条水路，青蛙都跳开了。
lines.en: I carve a waterway and the frogs scatter.

lines.zh: 走到巢口，三颗头一起低下去。
lines.en: At the nest mouth, all three heads dip.

lines.zh: 这么重的身子，走起来却没有声。
lines.en: For such weight, I move without a sound.

lines.zh: 九个头里，总有一颗在望风。
lines.en: Of nine heads, one always keeps watch.

lines.zh: 我碾过巢底的骨，声音很闷。
lines.en: I grind the bones on the nest floor, a muffled sound.

lines.zh: 三颗头在泥里打盹，只有一颗醒着。
lines.en: Three heads doze in the mud; only one stays awake.

lines.zh: 我把脖子绕在树干上，歇一歇。
lines.en: I coil my necks around a trunk to rest.

lines.zh: 沼泽的雾气贴着水面，我在里面。
lines.en: Swamp mist hugs the water, and I am inside it.

lines.zh: 断过的颈根发痒，新的头想长出来。
lines.en: My severed neck itches; new heads want to grow.

lines.zh: 二百五十点血，够我慢慢耗。
lines.en: Two hundred fifty health; I can outlast you.

lines.zh: 一颗头在舔鳞片，另一颗在发呆。
lines.en: One head licks its scales, another stares at nothing.

lines.zh: 我记得上次那颗头是怎么掉的。
lines.en: I remember how that last head came off.

lines.zh: 毒囊鼓着，等有东西靠近就喷。
lines.en: My venom sacs swell, ready for anything that nears.

lines.zh: 巢里的水只到我的腹鳞。
lines.en: The water in my nest barely reaches my belly scales.

lines.zh: 九颗头的影子，我只见过一次。
lines.en: I have seen the nine-headed shadow only once.

lines.zh: 树根缠住我的尾巴，我懒得挣。
lines.en: Roots snag my tail and I can't be bothered.

lines.zh: 我在地底巢穴里听上面的脚步。
lines.en: In my sunken nest I listen for footsteps above.

lines.zh: 腐肉的味道从泥里飘上来。
lines.en: The smell of rotten flesh rises from the mud.

lines.zh: 我这颗头困了，可另外两颗不肯睡。
lines.en: This head is sleepy, but the other two refuse.

lines.zh: 毒液在牙根慢慢积起来。
lines.en: Venom pools slowly at my fang roots.

lines.zh: 巢穴的顶很低，我蜷着身子。
lines.en: The lair roof is low; I curl up.

lines.zh: 三颗头同时转过来，你先看哪颗？
lines.en: Three heads turn at once; which do you watch?

lines.zh: 你身上的铁味，盖不住汗味。
lines.en: Your iron smell doesn't hide the sweat.

lines.zh: 我的瞳孔竖着，你大概不喜欢。
lines.en: My pupils are vertical; you probably dislike that.

lines.zh: 站那儿别动，我闻闻你带没带火。
lines.en: Stand still; let me smell whether you carry fire.

lines.zh: 有人在沼泽里点过火，我记住了。
lines.en: Someone lit a fire in my swamp once. I remember.

lines.zh: 一颗头盯着你，两颗在看你身后。
lines.en: One head watches you, two watch behind you.

lines.zh: 你以为砍掉一颗就赢了？
lines.en: You think cutting one head wins?

lines.zh: 我的毒牙露出来，是给你看的。
lines.en: I bare my fangs so you can see them.

lines.zh: 你退到干地上，我才懒得追。
lines.en: You step onto dry ground and I lose interest.

lines.zh: 两百五十点血，你的剑要挥很久。
lines.en: Two hundred fifty health; your sword will be busy.

lines.zh: 巢里有九颗头的空间，我还没填满。
lines.en: My nest has room for nine heads; I'm not full yet.

lines.zh: 你手里的火把，比剑更让我在意。
lines.en: That torch worries me more than your sword.

lines.zh: 一颗头被砍了，另外两颗在长。
lines.en: One head is gone; the other two are growing.

lines.zh: 这点伤，我的头会补回来。
lines.en: This wound? My heads will make it back.

lines.zh: 别砍颈根，除非你带了火。
lines.en: Don't cut the neck base unless you brought fire.

lines.zh: 蛇身缩了一下，又缠得更紧。
lines.en: My body recoils, then coils tighter.

lines.zh: 痛从三颗头一起来，很吵。
lines.en: Pain arrives from three heads at once, loudly.

lines.zh: 我的鳞裂了，泥水灌进去。
lines.en: A scale splits and swamp water seeps in.

lines.zh: 你砍得动，但杀不死我。
lines.en: You can cut, but you cannot kill me.

lines.zh: 剧痛中，新的头冒出了尖。
lines.en: Through the pain, a new head tips out.

lines.zh: 我发出嘶声，整片芦苇都在响。
lines.en: I hiss and the whole reed bed answers.

lines.zh: 只留一颗头时，我才会怕。
lines.en: Only when one head remains do I feel fear.

lines.zh: 腐肉的味儿，我从泥里抬起头。
lines.en: Rotten flesh; I raise my heads from the muck.

lines.zh: 你把肉丢下来，三颗头一起抢。
lines.en: You drop the meat; all three heads lunge.

lines.zh: 生的，血还没干，正合我口味。
lines.en: Raw, blood still wet, just how I like it.

lines.zh: 别走太近，我的脖子比腿长。
lines.en: Don't come closer; my necks reach farther than my legs.

lines.zh: 一颗头吞了，另外两颗在咬它。
lines.en: One head swallows and the other two bite it.

lines.zh: 我闻到肉味，毒囊都松了。
lines.en: I smell meat and my venom sacs loosen.

lines.zh: 扔远一点，我不想连你的手一起。
lines.en: Toss it farther; I'd rather not take your hand too.

lines.zh: 这点肉不够三颗头分。
lines.en: That much meat won't feed three heads.

lines.zh: 你喂我，我还是会咬你。
lines.en: You may feed me; I'll still bite you.

lines.zh: 我用舌尖卷起那块肉，慢慢咽。
lines.en: My tongue curls the morsel up and I swallow slow.

lines.zh: 沼泽里没什么可吃，腐肉也行。
lines.en: There's little to eat in the swamp; rotten will do.

lines.zh: 三颗头为了这块肉打起来了。
lines.en: The three heads are fighting over this scrap.

lines.zh: 我跟着味道挪了半步，就半步。
lines.en: I shift half a step toward the smell, only half.

lines.zh: 再扔一块，我就当你是有用的。
lines.en: Throw another and I'll consider you useful.

lines.zh: 你把腐肉挂高，我抬两颗头。
lines.en: Hang the rotten flesh high and I lift two heads.

lines.zh: 肉的味儿顺风过来，我转眼。
lines.en: Meat scent comes downwind and I turn my eye.

lines.zh: 你撞在我的鳞上，像撞一堵湿墙。
lines.en: You hit my scales like a wet wall.

lines.zh: 我的身子盘着，把你挤到泥里。
lines.en: My coiled body shoves you into the mud.

lines.zh: 蛇尾扫过来，你站不稳了。
lines.en: My tail sweeps across and your footing fails.

lines.zh: 别踩我的颈根，那里最敏感。
lines.en: Don't step on my neck base; it's the tender part.

lines.zh: 三颗头凑过来，你被围在中间。
lines.en: Three heads close in and you're in the middle.

lines.zh: 我挪了挪，让出一条泥路。
lines.en: I shift and open a muddy path.

lines.zh: 你这点分量，撞不动我。
lines.en: Your weight can't move me.

lines.zh: 尾尖勾住你的脚踝，又松开了。
lines.en: My tail tip hooks your ankle, then lets go.

lines.zh: 水花溅起来，我的头都转了。
lines.en: The splash makes every head turn.

lines.zh: 我被撞得缩了一下，随即缠上来。
lines.en: The bump makes me flinch, then I coil closer.

lines.zh: 两条蛇身缠在一起，泥都翻了。
lines.en: Two serpent bodies coil, churning the mud.

lines.zh: 我用一颗头轻轻碰她的颈。
lines.en: I touch her neck gently with one head.

lines.zh: 她比我多两颗头，我不敢乱动。
lines.en: She has two heads more; I hold still.

lines.zh: 巢底的泥要压实，蛋才不会被冲走。
lines.en: The nest floor must be packed or the eggs wash away.

lines.zh: 两颗头在争谁先靠近她。
lines.en: Two of my heads argue over who approaches first.

lines.zh: 沼泽的水温正好，我们把蛋埋进去。
lines.en: The swamp water is warm; we bury the eggs.

lines.zh: 她的毒牙碰到我，是示好。
lines.en: Her fangs brush mine; that is affection.

lines.zh: 我们的后代，一开始也只有三颗头。
lines.en: Our young will start with three heads too.

lines.zh: 我盘在她巢外，谁进来就咬谁。
lines.en: I coil outside her nest; anything entering gets bitten.

lines.zh: 缠得久了，鳞片都磨得发亮。
lines.en: Coiled that long, our scales rub bright.

lines.zh: 我用下颚叼起一颗蛋，很轻。
lines.en: I lift an egg in my jaws; it weighs almost nothing.

lines.zh: 这块骨头不错，能磨牙。
lines.en: This bone is good for grinding my fangs.

lines.zh: 我捡起毒牙，那是我自己掉的。
lines.en: I pick up a fang, one of my own.

lines.zh: 亮东西？沼泽里不多。
lines.en: Something shiny? Rare in a swamp.

lines.zh: 我叼着腐肉，三颗头都想抢。
lines.en: I carry the rotten flesh; all three heads want it.

lines.zh: 蛇尾卷起一块石头，随手扔了。
lines.en: My tail curls a stone up and tosses it away.

lines.zh: 这个铁块有点凉，硌牙。
lines.en: This iron chunk is cold and hard on my teeth.

lines.zh: 我把东西拖进巢底的泥里。
lines.en: I drag my find into the mud of the nest floor.

lines.zh: 一颗头衔着，另外两颗在看着。
lines.en: One head holds it; the other two watch.

lines.zh: 掉了就掉了，我不稀罕。
lines.en: Dropped is dropped; I don't care for it.

lines.zh: 有东西踏进浅水，三颗头都静了。
lines.en: Something steps into the shallows and all three heads go still.

lines.zh: 那头牛在岸边喝水，太近了。
lines.en: That cow drinks at the bank, far too close.

lines.zh: 你身上的血腥味，把我引来了。
lines.en: The smell of blood on you drew me here.

lines.zh: 一只落水的羊，我不用动。
lines.en: A sheep in the water; I needn't move.

lines.zh: 我盯上了走在最后的那个人。
lines.en: I've picked the one walking at the back.

lines.zh: 三颗头各自选了目标，最后统一了。
lines.en: Each head picks a target, then they agree.

lines.zh: 有人碰了我的蛋，我知道是谁。
lines.en: Someone touched my eggs. I know who.

lines.zh: 它还没发现我盘在芦苇后面。
lines.en: It hasn't noticed me coiled behind the reeds.

lines.zh: 这个猎物够大，够九颗头分。
lines.en: This prey is big enough for nine heads.

lines.zh: 我慢慢沉进水里，只露出眼睛。
lines.en: I sink slowly, leaving only my eyes above water.

lines.zh: 三颗头分开，堵住你三个方向。
lines.en: Three heads split and block three directions.

lines.zh: 我立起前半身，影子压过来。
lines.en: I rear up and my shadow falls over you.

lines.zh: 毒液在牙根积着，一滴一滴。
lines.en: Venom gathers at my fang roots, drop by drop.

lines.zh: 你举盾，我从侧面绕。
lines.en: You raise the shield; I circle to the side.

lines.zh: 低吼从三张嘴里一起出来。
lines.en: A low hiss rises from all three mouths.

lines.zh: 我把身子收成一圈，等你踩进来。
lines.en: I gather myself into a ring and wait.

lines.zh: 你身后那两颗头，已经抬起来了。
lines.en: The two heads behind you have already risen.

lines.zh: 蛇信一吐一收，量着你的距离。
lines.en: My tongues flick in and out, measuring range.

lines.zh: 我不急，沼泽会替我拖住你。
lines.en: I'm in no hurry; the swamp will slow you.

lines.zh: 断颈的火把，你带了吗？
lines.en: Did you bring fire for my neck stumps?

lines.zh: 毒牙咬进小腿，四秒就够。
lines.en: Fangs sink into your calf; four seconds is enough.

lines.zh: 三颗头轮流咬，你顾不过来。
lines.en: Three heads bite in turn; you can't cover them all.

lines.zh: 我一口毒液喷在你脸上。
lines.en: I spit venom straight into your face.

lines.zh: 蛇身缠上你的腰，越收越紧。
lines.en: My body coils your waist and tightens.

lines.zh: 一颗头咬住盾沿，另外两颗咬你。
lines.en: One head bites your shield rim, two bite you.

lines.zh: 这一口带毒，伤口会一直烧。
lines.en: This bite carries venom; the wound will burn.

lines.zh: 我用尾巴把你扫进泥里。
lines.en: My tail sweeps you down into the mud.

lines.zh: 别砍头，你会后悔的。
lines.en: Don't cut a head off; you'll regret it.

lines.zh: 咬完就退，我的脖子够长。
lines.en: I bite and pull back; my neck is long enough.

lines.zh: 一颗头被打偏，另外两颗补上。
lines.en: One head is knocked aside; two take its place.

lines.zh: 沼泽的水面鼓起，我先露出三颗头。
lines.en: The swamp surface bulges; three heads break through.

lines.zh: 我从巢底钻出来，泥顺着脖子流。
lines.en: I rise from the nest floor, mud streaming off my necks.

lines.zh: 这片沼泽有了主人。
lines.en: This swamp has a master now.

lines.zh: 芦苇丛里传来鳞片摩擦的声音。
lines.en: Scales rasp somewhere in the reeds.

lines.zh: 我的巢又大了一圈，树根都被拱开了。
lines.en: My nest has widened; roots are pushed aside.

lines.zh: 三颗头先闻到空气，才看见天。
lines.en: Three heads taste the air before they see sky.

lines.zh: 二百五十点血，落地时泥都在颤。
lines.en: Two hundred fifty health; the mud trembles as I land.

lines.zh: 我盘在巢中央，等第一只猎物上门。
lines.en: I coil at the nest's heart, waiting for the first prey.

lines.zh: 又一头九头蛇占了这片死水。
lines.en: Another hydra claims this dead water.

lines.zh: 我的头一次比一次多，你先数数。
lines.en: My heads multiply each time; start counting.

lines.zh: 火烧在断颈上，我的头再也长不出来。
lines.en: Fire on the stump and no head grows back.

lines.zh: 这么高摔下来，我的鳞片替我扛了。
lines.en: That fall was high; my scales took it.

lines.zh: 我在水里待惯了，淹不死。
lines.en: I live in water; drowning won't take me.

lines.zh: 爆炸把泥掀起来，我埋了半截。
lines.en: The blast throws mud and buries half of me.

lines.zh: 箭插在鳞缝里，像根刺。
lines.en: The arrow sticks in a scale seam like a thorn.

lines.zh: 那股魔力烧得我三颗头一起缩。
lines.en: That magic burns and all three heads pull back.

lines.zh: 饿瘦了，连蛇身都松了。
lines.en: Starved thin, even my coils hang loose.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我的头短暂地僵了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and my heads freeze briefly.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有泥，我的身子无处盘。
lines.en: No mud in the void; my body has nothing to coil on.
